name: Denise D Krause

bio.statement: In her voters' pamphlet statement, Krause lists her occupation as small business owner, with a background in healthcare and public health, a PhD in preventive medicine and service on the Rogue Valley Transportation District board.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Small Business Owner Occupational Background: Healthcare/Public Health, University of Mississippi Medical Center Educational Background: University of Kansas, BA; Monterey Institute of International Studies, MA; University of Mississippi Medical Center, MS, PhD, Preventive Medicine Prior Governmental Experience: Rogue Valley Transportation District Board

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 36

positions.statement: Krause says she won a fight with her insurer over her breast cancer treatment and, as Senator, would work to expand affordable, quality healthcare.
positions.excerpt: When I got diagnosed with breast cancer, Blue Cross Blue Shield denied me life-saving treatment. But I fought back and won, ensuring thousands of women have access to the treatments they need without insurance companies getting in the way.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 36

positions.statement: Krause says she would fight to lower the cost of living and to expand affordable, quality healthcare.
positions.excerpt: As your Senator, I’ll fight to: Lower the high cost of living Expand affordable, quality healthcare Get big money out of politics Safeguard public lands

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 36

positions.statement: Krause says she wants billionaires and wealthy corporations to pay their fair share to fund services such as healthcare, schools and wildfire prevention.
positions.excerpt: I’ll fight to ensure billionaires and wealthy corporations pay their fair share to fund the services we need

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 36

positions.statement: Krause lists wildfire prevention and firefighting efforts, and safeguarding public lands, among her priorities.
positions.excerpt: Wildfire prevention and firefighting efforts to keep us safe and protect our environment

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Jackson/Josephine edition (Book 3), p. 36

positions.statement: Krause says she would protect reproductive freedom, mail-in voting and civil rights.
positions.excerpt: Protect reproductive freedom, mail-in voting, and our civil rights
